decisions.reason: The source limits current META social-posting work to the Coastal Bazaar Picks account; it does not change product publication on the Coastal Bazaar Picks website.
The META account instruction changes the destination for daily social publishing but does not change the Google Drive content bank artifact or its storage platform.
The source concerns work in a META account and does not alter the separate requirement to publish products to TikTok Shop through CJ Dropshipping.
Restricting current social-posting work to one META account does not change the CJ Dropshipping product-sourcing platform.
The META account scope change does not alter which products are tracked or the requirement to add sourced products to the product list.
The source applies to daily social publishing in META and does not modify the independently specified daily Airbnb outreach.
The deferred HubSpot configuration requirement is unrelated to the META account selected for current social-posting work.
